coverage.note: Thirty-seven distinct URLs are inventoried: the original 36 source records plus direct r/codex product-discovery post S37. They include publisher homepages/docs/privacy/repos, App Store publisher listings, a direct community post, and three search-discovery artifacts. Several CUStats pages were loading/structurally incomplete and are marked coverage-only. Search and community posts were used for discovery, not allowance facts. The app landscape review is bounded, not exhaustive.
coverage.publication_date_handling: All 37 source records include retrieval date 2026-10-05 and publication/update date status. For S01-S24, source records state not stated unless dated explicitly; S14 notes Dec 2024, S15-S16 note Jul 2026, S17 Sep 28 2026, S18 privacy rechecked Sep 30 2026, S09 current repository revision Oct 5 2026. Store version recency and month/year gaps are labeled as shown or inferred in S29-S30 and S33-S36. S37's relative-time label does not establish a calendar date and is discovery-only. Older or undated pages are discovery/capability-only, never current empirical allowance evidence.
